siteTitle: Trip Connect | Kerala Tour Packages, Luxury Taxi & Bus Booking Kochi
metaDescription: Award-winning tour operator in Kochi offering luxury Kerala holiday packages, Munnar tea trail tours, Alleppey houseboats, chauffeur car rentals, and All-India Volvo sleeper bus charters.

name: Munnar
shortDescription: Colonial tea plantations, morning mist, and sprawling hill ranges.
description: Nestled in the Western Ghats at an altitude of 1,600 meters, Munnar is Kerala's premier hill resort. Renowned for boundless sprawling tea plantations, picture-book towns, winding lanes, and Anamudi, the highest peak in South India.

seo.metaTitle: Munnar Kerala Tour Packages | Curated Tea Estates & Hills
seo.metaDescription: Discover Munnar with Trip Connect. Bespoke highland itineraries, private tea-tasting sessions, and Anamudi treks.

name: Alleppey
shortDescription: Canals, mirror-smooth lagoons, and traditional luxury houseboats.
description: Often described as the Venice of the East, Alappuzha (Alleppey) is the hub of Kerala's backwaters, home to a vast network of waterways and thousands of houseboats cruising along palm-fringed canals.

seo.metaTitle: Alleppey Backwater & Houseboat Tours | Trip Connect Kochi
seo.metaDescription: Private overnight Alleppey luxury houseboats with personal onboard chefs. Handcrafted Kerala backwater journeys.

name: Wayanad
shortDescription: Subtropical rainforest sanctuaries, prehistoric rock caves, and treehouses.
description: Set high on the Western Ghats, Wayanad is pristine, mountainous, and wild. Renowned for spice plantations, trekking routes, Edakkal caves, and luxury treetop retreats overlooking deep forest valleys.

seo.metaTitle: Wayanad Nature & Rainforest Tours | Trip Connect
seo.metaDescription: Treehouse stays, private bamboo rafting, and guided spice walks in Wayanad Kerala.

name: Varkala
shortDescription: Red laterite sea cliffs, mineral springs, and serene Arabian Sea sunsets.
description: Varkala is famous for its unique geological coastal cliff running alongside the Arabian Sea, natural mineral water springs, peaceful beaches, and ancient Janardhana Swamy Temple.

seo.metaTitle: Varkala Beach & Cliff Tours | Trip Connect Kerala
seo.metaDescription: Red cliffside serenity and luxury beachside retreats in Varkala, Kerala.

name: Kochi
shortDescription: Historic spice trade port, colonial architecture, and Chinese fishing nets.
description: Kochi (Cochin) is Kerala's commercial and cultural gateway. Fort Kochi, Mattancherry palace, Jew Town, and Chinese fishing nets showcase centuries of Portuguese, Dutch, and British maritime heritage.

seo.metaTitle: Kochi Port & Culture Tours | Trip Connect
seo.metaDescription: Explore Fort Kochi, heritage cafes, and cultural performances curated from our native Kochi desk.

name: Thekkady
shortDescription: Periyar wildlife reserve, spice hills, and aromatic cardamom plantations.
description: Thekkady is home to the Periyar National Park, one of India's most fascinating natural wildlife reserves where wild elephants, sambars, and birds flourish around Periyar Lake.

seo.metaTitle: Thekkady Wildlife & Spice Tours | Trip Connect
seo.metaDescription: Periyar lake boat safari, spice garden tours, and authentic elephant sanctuaries in Thekkady.

name: Rajasthan
shortDescription: Majestic hill forts, royal palaces, and Thar desert dunes.
description: From Jaipur's pink-hued palaces to Jodhpur's blue alleys and Udaipur's lake romanticism, Rajasthan represents the pinnacle of Indian royal heritage and desert luxury.

seo.metaTitle: Rajasthan Heritage Tour Packages | Trip Connect
seo.metaDescription: Royal palace stays, desert safaris, and private guided circuits in Rajasthan.

name: Kashmir
shortDescription: Alpine meadows, glassy Dal Lake shikaras, and snowbound peaks.
description: Srinagar, Gulmarg, and Pahalgam offer timeless mountain tranquility. Experience private wooden houseboat stays on Dal Lake and snow-framed mountain valleys.

seo.metaTitle: Kashmir Valley & Shikara Tours | Trip Connect
seo.metaDescription: Bespoke Kashmir journeys with private Shikara rides, Gulmarg gondola excursions, and boutique stays.

title: Classic Kerala Grand Tour
shortDescription: Multi-destination balanced circuit across God’s Own Country with luxury tea resort, spice plantation walk, and overnight private backwater houseboat.
description: The quintessential journey through Kerala, balanced carefully between historical colonial ports, cool misty tea mountains, lush spice hills, and tranquil backwaters. Every transfer is managed with a dedicated private air-conditioned vehicle and professional chauffeur, ensuring effortless pacing without rigid tour-bus schedules.
highlights: Private overnight luxury houseboat with dedicated onboard chef in Alleppey
Guided tea museum and private plantation walking tour in Munnar
Periyar lake boat safari and spice garden walk in Thekkady
Traditional Kathakali and Kalaripayattu martial arts cultural evening
Fort Kochi colonial architecture and Chinese fishing nets tour

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cochin & Fort Kochi Heritage
itinerary.description: Arrive at Cochin International Airport (COK). Meet your dedicated chauffeur and transfer to your boutique hotel in Fort Kochi. Spend the afternoon exploring colonial lanes, St. Francis Church, and Chinese Fishing Nets at sunset.
itinerary.activity: Fort Kochi Walking Tour & Chinese Fishing Nets

itinerary.title: Scenic Ascent to Munnar Highlands
itinerary.description: Drive through rolling green foothills to Munnar, pausing at Cheeyappara and Valara waterfalls. Check in to your highland resort nestled among mist-covered tea slopes.
itinerary.activity: Waterfall Photo Stops & Resort Welcome High Tea

itinerary.title: Munnar Tea Estates & Anamudi Foothills
itinerary.description: Explore the Tata Tea Museum with an artisanal tea tasting. In the afternoon, visit Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point, and take a gentle stroll through private estate trails.
itinerary.activity: Private Tea Tasting & Eravikulam National Park Visit

itinerary.title: Cardamom Hills of Thekkady (Periyar)
itinerary.description: Depart for Thekkady along winding mountain corridors flanked by cardamom and pepper vines. In the evening, witness an authentic Kathakali dance and Kalaripayattu performance.
itinerary.activity: Guided Spice Plantation Walk & Cultural Performance

itinerary.title: Periyar Lake Wildlife & Transfer to Alleppey
itinerary.description: Morning boat cruise along Periyar Lake to spot wild elephants and birdlife. Proceed to Alleppey by afternoon to embark on your private luxury handcrafted wooden Kettuvallam.
itinerary.activity: Lake Safari & Houseboat Boarding with Kerala Welcome Lunch

itinerary.title: Serene Backwater Canals & Village Life
itinerary.description: Awake to gentle morning waters and mirror-smooth lagoons. Cruise through peaceful village canals where coir making and paddy farming thrive. Enjoy fresh Karimeen fish prepared by your personal chef.
itinerary.activity: Village Canoe Excursion & Stargazing Deck Dinner

itinerary.title: Disembarkation & Cochin Airport Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast on the water, disembark at Alleppey jetty. Your private chauffeur transfers you back to Cochin Airport with cherished memories.
itinerary.activity: Airport Transfer with Local Souvenir Desk Assistance

title: Munnar Cloud Mist & Tea Trails
shortDescription: Ascend to colonial tea estates, private tea-tasting sessions, and dawn treks across Anamudi foothills.
description: Immerse yourself in the cool highland tranquility of Munnar. Stay in charming colonial plantation bungalows, wake up above the morning cloud blanket, and breathe the fresh mountain air.
highlights: Colonial tea plantation resort stay with mountain views
Private guided tea-plucking and tasting session
Dawn safari to Eravikulam National Park to spot Nilgiri Tahr
Picnic by Mattupetty Dam and Echo Point

itinerary.title: Cochin to Munnar Highland Ascent
itinerary.description: Pickup from Cochin and transfer to Munnar through scenic mountain passes and cascading water streams. Check in and unwind with panoramic valley vistas.

itinerary.title: Tea Estates, Museum & High Altitude Views
itinerary.description: Visit KDHP Tea Museum to discover century-old machinery and artisan tea production methods. Stroll through sculpted tea slopes with an expert botanist.

itinerary.title: Wildlife Trails & Kundala Lake
itinerary.description: Morning expedition to Eravikulam National Park. Afternoon pedal boating on the reflective waters of Kundala Lake flanked by pine groves.

itinerary.title: Morning Mist Walk & Cochin Drop
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely sunrise tea on your balcony before your private chauffeur transfers you back to Cochin Airport or Railway Station.

inclusions: 3 Nights luxury tea estate view room
Daily buffet breakfast
Dedicated air-conditioned sedan with chauffeur
Tea museum entry and tea tasting experience

title: Alleppey Luxury Backwater Cruise
shortDescription: Drift along palm-lined canals with dedicated private onboard chef, artisan village stops, and starry nights.
description: Experience the magic of Kerala's lagoons aboard a private traditional wooden houseboat built using ancient anjili wood and coir ropes, retrofitted with air-conditioned luxury bedrooms and a spacious observation sundeck.
highlights: 1 Night on a private luxury air-conditioned houseboat
1 Night at a boutique lakeside backwater resort
Live cooking of fresh Kerala delicacies by private onboard chef
Canoe ride into narrow palm canals inaccessible to larger boats

itinerary.title: Embarkation on Private Houseboat
itinerary.description: Board your private houseboat at Alleppey jetty at noon. Enjoy a traditional Kerala lunch served on banana leaf as the boat glides across Vembanad Lake.

itinerary.title: Canal Walk & Lakeside Resort Relaxation
itinerary.description: Disembark after breakfast and transfer to a premier lakeside resort. Spend the afternoon swimming, getting an Ayurvedic wellness treatment, or watching sunset over the lake.

itinerary.title: Morning Canoe Safari & Return
itinerary.description: Early morning silent country canoe ride into narrow canals. Check out and transfer to Cochin Airport.

inclusions: 1 Night private 1-bedroom luxury houseboat (all meals included)
1 Night 5-star backwater resort with breakfast
Private AC transfers Cochin-Alleppey-Cochin

title: Wayanad Rainforest Sanctuary
shortDescription: Treehouse stays, prehistoric Edakkal rock caves exploration, and guided bamboo rafting on quiet rivers.
description: Deep in the Western Ghats, Wayanad holds ancient rainforests and misty peaks. Stay in an eco-luxury treehouse surrounded by birdsong and ancient bamboo groves.
highlights: Private treehouse or forest villa stay
Trek to prehistoric Edakkal Caves with rock engravings
Kuruva Island bamboo rafting experience
Soochipara waterfall dip and spice plantation tour

itinerary.title: Arrival into Wayanad Rainforest
itinerary.description: Transfer from Calicut or Cochin up the serpentine Thamarassery Churam ghat pass to Wayanad. Check in to your forest retreat.

itinerary.title: Edakkal Rock Art & Pookode Lake
itinerary.description: Hike up Ambukuthi Mala to view Neolithic cave petroglyphs at Edakkal. Afternoon paddle boating at Pookode freshwater lake.

itinerary.title: Bamboo Rafting & Waterfalls
itinerary.description: Visit Kuruva Island on the Kabini River for bamboo rafting. Later, trek through dense foliage to the multi-tiered Soochipara falls.

itinerary.title: Morning Birding Walk & Departure
itinerary.description: Guided morning birdwatching trail in the resort's private reserve before transferring to Calicut / Cochin airport.

inclusions: 3 Nights luxury treehouse or forest villa stay
Daily breakfast and dinner
Private vehicle for all sightseeing and airport transfers
Bamboo rafting permits and cave entry tickets

title: Golden Triangle & Rajasthan
shortDescription: Privileged sunrise tour at Taj Mahal, Amber Fort jeep safari, and restored heritage Haveli stays across Delhi, Agra, and Jaipur.
description: India's most iconic cultural circuit, connecting the capital of Delhi, the Mughal splendor of Agra, and the royal Rajput majesty of Jaipur. Curated with private licensed guides, luxury heritage stays, and effortless intercity chauffeurs.
highlights: Exclusive sunrise viewing of the Taj Mahal in Agra
Amber Fort jeep safari and private City Palace courtyards in Jaipur
Restored heritage Haveli stays with traditional Rajput hospitality
Old Delhi rickshaw food and spice market tour

itinerary.title: Delhi Arrival & Old/New Delhi Heritage
itinerary.description: Arrive in New Delhi. Tour Qutub Minar, Humayun's Tomb, and experience an authentic rickshaw ride through Chandni Chowk spice markets.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Agra & Agra Fort
itinerary.description: Drive on the express highway to Agra. Check in to your hotel and visit the imposing red sandstone Agra Fort overlooking the Yamuna River.

itinerary.title: Sunrise at Taj Mahal & Journey to Jaipur
itinerary.description: Witness the morning sun illuminate the ivory marble Taj Mahal. Journey towards Jaipur with a stop at the abandoned Mughal city of Fatehpur Sikri.

itinerary.title: The Pink City: Amber Fort & Hawa Mahal
itinerary.description: Ascend Amber Fort by vintage jeep. In the afternoon, photograph Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds), and tour the private royal astronomical observatory at Jantar Mantar.

itinerary.title: Artisans of Jaipur & Royal Palaces
itinerary.description: Visit traditional block-printing and gem ateliers. Evening private dinner in the courtyards of a royal heritage Haveli.

itinerary.title: Jaipur to Delhi International Airport
itinerary.description: Private chauffeur transfer back to New Delhi Airport for your onward international or domestic departure.

inclusions: 5 Nights luxury heritage & 5-star hotel accommodations
Daily breakfast
Private AC vehicle with dedicated intercity driver
Government-approved licensed local English-speaking guides
Monument entries and Old Delhi rickshaw tour
accommodationDetails: Delhi 5-Star (1N) • Agra Luxury Hotel (1N) • Jaipur Heritage Haveli (2N) • Delhi (1N)

seo.metaTitle: Golden Triangle Tour Delhi Agra Jaipur (5N/6D) | Trip Connect
seo.metaDescription: Sunrise Taj Mahal, Amber Fort jeep safari, and restored heritage havelis.

shortDescription: Artisan coffee estate homestay, Iruppu & Soochipara waterfall treks, and Malabar & Kodava culinary trails.

Iruppu and Soochipara waterfall nature trails
